title: Audit partition dropped
description: An audit events partition was dropped according to the retention policy (plan P1-02, step 9).

partition.description: The name of the dropped partition table.

from_time.description: Start of the partition's ingestion time range.

to_time.description: End of the partition's ingestion time range.

from_leaf_index.description: Lowest leaf index in the pruned partition, if any.

to_leaf_index.description: Exclusive upper bound leaf index in the pruned partition, if any.

events_count.description: Number of audit events dropped with the partition.

retention_days.description: The retention window in days that prompted the drop.
